paite: Judah leh Jerusalem sal tengteng, Babulon sal a apite uh lak a Jeremiah khainiang len kawm a api lai a ngakmi apawtsak nung a TOUPA a kipan Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung hi.
heading: Gedaliah Kiang Ah Jeremiah A-om
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who were carried away captive to Babylon.

paite: Ngakmi heutu in Jeremiah api a, akiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian in hiai mun a thil hoih lou tung ding ana puang khin hi.
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah and said to him, “Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

paite: TOUPA'N ahon tungsakta ngei a, agen bangbang in ahihta hi; TOUPA tung ah thil na hihkhial ua, apaukam na man louh ziak un hiai thil na tung ua ahong tung ahi.
english: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke. Because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

paite: Tu in, ngai in, tuni in na khut a khainiang but ka hon phelsak hi. Babulon a ka kiang a hong na utleh hong inla, na ut keileh hong dah mai in; en dih, gam tengteng na ma ah a-om hi, hong hoh pha na sakleh hoih na sak bang in pai in.
english: Now, behold, I release you today from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t. Behold, all the land is before you. Where it seems good and right to you to go, go there.”

paite: Akik ma in ama'n, Judah khopite tung a ukpi dia Babulon kumpipa'n abawl Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah kik inla, mite lak ah akiang ah om in, ahihkeileh hoh pha na sakna ah va hoh mai in," achi hi. Huchi in ngakmi heutu in nek ding leh thilpiak apia a, apaisakta hi.
english: Now while he had not yet gone back, “Go back then,” he said, “to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go.” So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.

paite: Jeremiah bel Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah Mizpah ah ahoh a, akiang a gam a omsun mite lak ah a-om teita hi.
english: Then Jeremiah went to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

paite: Huan sepaih pawl heutu tengteng gamlak a omte'n, amaute leh aheute uh Babulon kumpipa'n, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah huai gam a migenthei penpen, Babulon sal a pilouhte akemsak chih azak un Mizpah khua ah;
heading: Judah Gam Ukpipa Gedaliah / (2 Kum 25.22-24)
english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, women, children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon,

paite: Gedaliah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapate Johanan leh Jonathan, Tanhumet tapa Seraiah, Netophah a Ephai tate leh Maakath mi tapa Jezaniah, amau leh amite uh toh.
english: then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.

paite: Huchi in Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in amau leh aheute uh kiang ah, "Kaldaite nasep kihta kei un; gam ah om dinden unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem unla, noute a ding in ahoih mai ding hi.
english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, “Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.

paite: Kei zaw Mizpah ah ka om ding a, Kaldai mi ka kiang a hong dingte ma ah noute sik in ka dingh ding; noute'n ahihleh uainte, nipitheite, thaute lakhawm in na bel uah koih unla, na khopi laksate uah teng un," chi in akichiam hi.
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who will come to us; but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.”

paite: Huchi mah bang in Juda mi tengteng, Moab gam a tengte, Ammon mite lak a tengte leh Edom gam a tengte leh gamdang a omte'n Babulon kumpipa'n Judah khosuaksunte nusia a, atung uah Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa, Gedaliah akoih chih azak un;
english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan,

paite: Juda mi tengteng ahawlzakna gam tengteng ua kipan in ahong paikik ua, Judah gam a Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahong tung ua, uain leh nipithei alakhawm uhi.
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered very much wine and summer fruits.

paite: Huai lou leng Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawlte heutu, gamlak a om tengteng Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah,
heading: Gedaliah Thahna / (2 Kum 25.25-26)
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

paite: "Ammon mite kumpipa Baalis in na hinna la ding in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael asawl chih na za hia?" achi uhi.
english: and said to him, “Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life?” But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.

paite: Huan Kareah tapa Johanan in Mizpah a Gedaliah kiang ah, "Hon paisak dih ve, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael ka va that mai ding, kuamah in athei kei ding uh; Juda mi na kiang omkhawm tengteng adalh vek ua, Judah mi khosuaksunte manthatna hih ding in bangziak a na hinna la ding ahia?" chi in asimtham in agen hi.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, “Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man will know it. Why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?”

paite: Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in bel Kareah tapa Johanan kiang ah, "Hiai thil na hih ding ahi kei; Ishmael na gendan adik kei hi," achi hi.
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, “You shall not do this thing, for you speak falsely of Ishmael.”
